title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Obstructing National Border (Frontier) Management

articles.content_en:
Article 1 Any person who leads, plans, or directs others to illegally cross the national border (frontier), or under the command of a ringleader, engages in acts such as soliciting, enticing, or introducing others to illegally cross the national border (frontier), shall be determined as "organizing others to illegally cross the national border (frontier)" as provided for in Article 318 of the Criminal Law.
Where the number of persons organized to illegally cross the national border (frontier) is ten or more, it shall be determined as "a large number of persons" as provided for in paragraph (2) of the first paragraph of Article 318 of the Criminal Law; where the amount of illegal gains is 200,000 RMB or more, it shall be determined as "a huge amount of illegal gains" as provided for in paragraph (6) of the first paragraph of Article 318 of the Criminal Law.
Where, for the purpose of organizing others to illegally cross the national border (frontier), a person recruits, solicits, entices, introduces, or trains persons to illegally cross the national border (frontier), plans or arranges acts of illegally crossing the national border (frontier), and is discovered before or during the course of such illegal crossing, the person shall be convicted and punished for the crime of organizing others to illegally cross the national border (frontier) (attempted); if any of the circumstances provided for in the first paragraph of Article 318 of the Criminal Law exists, the sentence shall be imposed within the corresponding statutory punishment range, taking into account the sentencing principles for attempted offenders.

Article 4 Where the number of persons transported to illegally cross the national border (frontier) is ten or more, it shall be determined as "a large number of persons" as provided for in subparagraph (1) of the first paragraph of Article 321 of the Criminal Law; where the amount of illegal gains is 200,000 RMB or more, it shall be determined as "a huge amount of illegal gains" as provided for in subparagraph (3) of the first paragraph of Article 321 of the Criminal Law.

Article 7 Where, in the name of a unit or in the form of a unit, a person organizes others to illegally cross the national border (frontier), provides others with forged or altered exit-entry documents, or transports others to illegally cross the national border (frontier), the directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons shall be investigated for criminal liability in accordance with Articles 318, 320, and 321 of the Criminal Law.

Article 8 Where the crime of organizing others to illegally cross the national border (frontier) is committed and at the same time constitutes the crime of fraudulently obtaining exit documents, the crime of providing forged or altered exit-entry documents, the crime of selling exit-entry documents, or the crime of transporting others to illegally cross the national border (frontier), the conviction and punishment shall be in accordance with the provisions providing for a heavier punishment.

Article 9 Where different crimes against border (frontier) management committed across different regions meet the requirements for consolidated handling, and the relevant local public security organs register the cases and conduct investigation together in accordance with the law and relevant regulations, if it is necessary to request approval for arrest, transfer for review and prosecution, or initiate public prosecution, the matter shall be accepted by the People's Procuratorate and the People's Court at the same level as the place where the public security organ is located according to law.

Article 10 After this Interpretation is issued and takes effect, the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases such as Organizing and Transporting Others to Illegally Cross the National Border (Frontier) (Fa Shi [2002] No. 3) shall no longer apply.
